real_production_replay.must_initialize: agent_company.db.Store.init plus AssuranceKernel, TrustedEvaluator and PilotGate real schemas in an isolated temporary workspace
real_production_replay.must_invoke: the named public production control entrypoint for each frozen case
real_production_replay.must_verify: an executable repository implementation must independently validate replay evidence; status flags and attestation booleans alone cannot certify treatment
real_production_replay.must_preserve: before mutation observation rollback after audit and noninterference evidence for every case

threshold_rule.required_observations: exactly one well-formed observation for each of the 13 named material faults and 3 named controls
